# wso2is_vc_template (Resource)

Manages a verifiable credential template (WSO2 IS 7.3 and later, OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance). The template describes a credential that digital wallets can request: its format, the user attributes that it carries and how long it is valid. The server creates a credential offer for the template. To import, use the template ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Custom attributes reach credentials through the VC claim dialect.
resource "wso2is_external_claim" "department_vc" {
  dialect_uri            = "http://wso2.org/vc/claim"
  claim_uri              = "department"
  mapped_local_claim_uri = "http://wso2.org/claims/department"
}

resource "wso2is_vc_template" "employee_badge" {
  identifier   = "EmployeeBadge"
  display_name = "Employee badge"
  format       = "dc+sd-jwt"
  expires_in   = 31536000 # one year
  claims = {
    given_name  = "given_name"
    family_name = "family_name"
    email       = "email"
    department  = wso2is_external_claim.department_vc.claim_uri
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claims` (Map of String) The claims in the credential. Each key is a claim name in the credential. Each value is a claim of the `http://wso2.org/vc/claim` dialect, for example `{ given_name = "given_name", mail = "email" }`. To use a custom attribute, first map it into that dialect with `wso2is_external_claim`.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown to users and wallets.
- `expires_in` (Number) Lifetime of issued credentials in seconds (at least 60).
- `identifier` (String) Stable identifier of the credential type (published as `credential_configuration_id`), for example `EmployeeBadge`. Changing it replaces the template.

### Optional

- `format` (String) Credential format: `jwt_vc_json` (default) or `dc+sd-jwt` (selective disclosure).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Template ID.
- `offer_id` (String) ID of the credential offer the server generated for the template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_vc_template.employee_badge <template_id>
```
